items.label: Material
items.value: Crafted from 93% polyester and 7% spandex, this women’s blouse offers a lightweight and breathable feel with just the right amount of stretch. The fabric drapes beautifully without clinging—perfect for staying comfortable and polished from morning meetings to evening plans.

items.label: Design
items.value: Features a chic mock neck and delicate front pleats that elevate the neckline, while the puffed long sleeves with gathered cuffs and slight shoulder pleating add a soft, feminine touch. A flattering silhouette that combines structure and flow for everyday elegance.

items.label: Match
items.value: Effortlessly pairs with jeans, tailored trousers, or skirts. Whether tucked in for a sleek look or worn loose for casual charm, this long sleeve blouse complements heels, ankle boots, or flats—making it a staple piece for year-round styling.

items.label: Occasion
items.value: Ideal for a wide range of occasions including office wear, business casual settings, brunches, weekend travel, and everyday outings. The versatile design transitions easily from day to night, offering timeless style for workdays and weekends alike.
